title: Resource fallbacks for the two OOM'd candidates of H20-FM-RICH (tabicl, causilo)
motivation: In the H20-FM-RICH screen, tabicl and causilo FAILED with CUDA OOM (16 GB) at the frozen recipe (20k context, 285 features, full fold-0 eval). Their mechanism was never measured: a resource failure is NOT a negative. These fallbacks change ONLY the resource footprint, chosen now, before either model produces a single prediction on the rich view. No metric has been observed for either candidate on this view, so no metric-dependent choice is possible -- this is a pure resource adaptation.

tabicl.change: pass disk_offload_dir=artifacts/phase19/foundation_screen/_tabicl_offload to TabICLClassifier (supported API per the OOM error message); all other args identical to the frozen recipe
tabicl.rationale: the OOM was in TabICL's internal output allocation (est. 15528 MB) with offloading disabled; disk offload is the library's own escape hatch and does not alter the model or its predictions

causilo.change: context reduced 20000 -> 8192 (stratified, same CONTEXT_SEED=20261023); all other args identical
causilo.rationale: causilo's context attention memory is quadratic in context rows; 8192 is the largest power-of-two context that fits 16 GB at 285 features; a context-size change affects information, not labels -- no leakage risk
causilo.deviation_note: this deviates from the frozen 20k context of H20-FM-RICH; any result is labeled as the 8k-context arm and, if it were ever PROMISING, the 20k arm would still be owed before a full OOF

decision_rule: identical to H20-FM-RICH: PROMISING = portfolio_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr < 0.995; otherwise the FLM x rich-view direction closes together with the tabdpt result (-7.857e-4) and the xrfm degenerate run (AUC 0.589141, treated as a failed mechanism, not a measurement).
anti_leakage: unchanged from H20-FM-RICH (fold-safe TE, context subset of FIT, hash-asserted champion reference).
